correctness.rationale: Defined the actual birth-death transition on three-bit mutant masks with fitness-proportional parent and uniform neighbor replacement, including self-loops. Two connected phases yield a 6x6 transient backward system for the boundary-aligned 2tau-update product. Independently solved this system in exact fractions at 30,58,86,114 positive integer fitness values respectively for tau=1..4, matching the claimed rational A_tau/B_tau certificate and verifying the coefficient identity for S_tau. The original proof establishes the rational numerator/denominator degree bound <=24tau by Cramer on entries with denominator ((r+2)(2r+1))^(2tau), so cross-multiplication has degree <=28tau+1; those 28tau+2 distinct exact rational checks prove identity for all r>0, not just finite samples. S1,S2 have strictly negative coefficients, S4 strictly positive; S3=r^5 H(r+1/r-2) with H(0)<0 and all positive higher coefficients yields exactly one root r*>1 and reciprocal. Static constituent path formula checked separately, and minimality of three sites follows from uniqueness of a connected 2-vertex simple graph.
